title: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
provenance: launch path tested locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro, macOS 14.6, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r0); the game itself was never reached
notes: Does not currently start. PlayGTAV.exe hands off to the Rockstar Games Launcher for sign-in, the launcher's embedded-browser UI never paints on this Wine build, and PlayGTAV then reports "Unable to launch game." The Rockstar service handshake and heap issues are already worked around by Highball; what remains is a loader-level fix that currently exists only in CrossOver's Wine. This is the 2025 re-release and a different Steam product from GTA V (Legacy). Online is BattlEye protected regardless.

requiresLauncher.name: Rockstar Games Launcher
requiresLauncher.note: Required for sign-in. Its embedded-browser UI does not render on this Wine build.

anticheat.note: GTA Online only; BattlEye's Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS.
